supersedes.note: An earlier run of this file reported ov_intent_analysis_sft and qwen3.5:9b at 0/8. Those numbers measured two harness bugs, not the models, and must not be cited.
bugs: callOllama never sent think:false and read only Ollama's `response` field. Thinking-capable models answer in `thinking` and leave `response` empty, so every call returned '' and failed schema validation. Fixed in src/extraction/localLLMProvider.ts.

expectedTimes are Asia/Jerusalem wall-clock but were substring-matched against a UTC ISO dueAt. A correct local 05:00 (02:00Z) was scored wrong, and an answer three hours off passed because '08:00Z' contains '08:00'. Fixed in scripts/run-dialect-eval.ts via localClock().

caveats: Four Arabic sentences cannot calibrate a threshold. ESCALATION_THRESHOLDS remains provisional until the 42 owner-authored cases exist.
All three candidates score identically on Arabic (3/4). The seed set does not separate them; the overall spread is driven entirely by the two English cases.
A multi-commitment case is now scored on the split alone: one ExtractionResult carries one dueAt, so there is no room to answer two expected times.
The plan's Step 6 stop-condition (below 0.5 on Arabic) is not tripped: every candidate is at 0.75.
